results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article detailing Professor Fabio Giglietto's research on how Meta's algorithms and political content reduction policies drastically cut down the reach of Italian parliamentarians on Facebook while raising the visibility of extremist accounts. Giglietto is interviewed and explains the asymmetric effects of the policy.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: Media coverage of Fabio Giglietto's study 'A Pretty Blunt Approach,' which analyzed the impact of Meta's content reduction policies. The article highlights how his scientific findings sparked a formal inquiry in the European Parliament and were featured in an investigative broadcast of 'Report' on Rai3.
